title: Caroline Dell's notes from the Masters of Scale stage — 'An organization that can't be trusted can't endure'
summary: Dell, CEO and co-founder of Goodword and a summit partner, wrote up the Presidio two days with the observation that every main-stage session was about AI and every note she took was about people. Her record of Eric's session is the clearest account so far of the argument he made from that stage, and she sets it alongside Sarah Friar and Reid Hoffman on the same theme. Her own closing line is that the tools got cheaper this year and trust did not.
blockquote: Eric Ries: An organization that can’t be trusted can’t endure. Trustworthiness is an asset, and it powers everything else.
